about.title: iSense Technologies
about.p1: iSense technologies by Ellis Trading House PLC is a leading security solutions provider in Ethiopia with over 15 years of experience. iSense technologies specializes in the distribution, configuration, and support of complete IP security solutions from the world’s leading products and brands at affordable prices.
about.p2: We assist clients with configuration and commissioning of physical security systems including CCTV, Access control, Fire alarm, Burglary alarm, metal/luggage detection solutions as well as last mile Fintech solutions.
about.profile: For more than 15 years, we’ve been passionate about achieving better results for our clients.
about.partner: Your partner for safer, smarter security solutions. We are a technology-driven company based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, founded in 2007. We are a leading product and solution provider, systems integrator, and distributor of sophisticated Electronic Security, Safety, Surveillance, and Biometric systems/solutions.
about.vision: To provide high quality, affordable and reliable physical security products and services through the expertise of our competent and seasoned professionals.
about.mission: Taking physical security and automated workforce to the next level.
about.serviceMindedBody: We understand the importance of customer support, always striving to deliver a superior customer experience.
about.innovativeBody: We are always on the lookout for innovative new products and solutions to bring to market and finding new means of application.
about.flexibleBody: We use our expert knowledge and extensive partner network to deliver innovative and customized solutions that meet our clients' specific needs.
about.why: Providing quality products and services has always been our manifesto in giving incredible service for so many years setting us apart from our competition and putting us on the front seat in becoming your trusted security solutions provider.

services.industryBody: iSense Technologies integrates all systems to provide a designed solution to monitor factory and site perimeters, manufacturing production lines or factory robots and send alerts if something unusual occurs by utilizing CCTV, fire alarm, Biometric Time Attendance, access control, ID solutions, metal detector and intruder Alarm system to give you a command-and-control center, which can ensure compliance to the strictest security ensuring business continuity.
services.governmentBody: Government organizations of all sizes benefit from our solutions video management systems to improve public safety, Biometric time & attendance system within government facilities reduces your administrative burden, eliminates lost wages due to time sheet errors or 'buddy punching', and allows you to generate real-time reports on employee attendance and job costing.
services.hotelsBody: Hotels should take basic steps and utilize sophisticated security techniques to overcome the numerous risks that they face. Here at iSense technologies we provide the latest and the best technologies card key, locks, safes and biometric systems, CCTV systems to monitor, record and camera/video surveillance of a hotel premises and various devices and programs to protect proprietary information of the Hotel and their guests.
services.commercialBody: Shoplifting, fraud, and inventory shrinkage have a significant effect on the profits of retailers each year. Hundreds of video devices, motion detectors, fire alarms, metal detectors and access control systems are used throughout the world to protect these Commercial establishments. With the solutions we provide, commercial enterprises can prevent these activities and recover lost items.
services.healthcareBody: In a healthcare setting, patients might exhibit disorderly conduct. Even non-violent disorderly conduct can have deadly consequences. However, by implementing a network of video surveillance cameras, as well as access control technology and hospital-wide security protocols, a hospital’s security personnel can help deter and mitigate disorderly conduct—before it escalates and becomes a serious distraction for doctors and nurses.
services.bankingBody: We provide advanced Security Solutions for your Bank. Our understanding of the business environment where the solution will be used is crucial ensuring that the solution has all the capabilities to meet your needs. Whether It's Access Control, Surveillance Camera or Fire Alarm. Our in-depth experience of Security services industry allows us to work with you to design a security system that will protect your employees, facilities, and your client’s assets.

products.title: IP security hardware and Unif1ed HRM
products.lead: Complete IP security solutions from the world’s leading products and brands, plus our in-house workforce platform.
products.cctvBody: Network and analog video surveillance for perimeters, interiors, and command-and-control rooms.
products.domeBody: Compact ceiling and corridor domes with night vision and a vandal-resistant shell.
products.bulletBody: Weatherproof bullet cameras for perimeters and long corridors.
products.ptzBody: Pan, tilt, and zoom to cover yards, parking, and large halls from one head.
products.nvrBody: Network video recorders with RAID-ready storage and a command-centre output.
products.accessBody: Access control is focused on controlling who has access, e.g. to an office or facility. This is typically achieved by restricting access by certain types of groups or access levels.
products.attendanceBody: Biometric time and attendance with fingerprint, face, card, and PIN — unified across manufacturers.
products.intrusionBody: Detect attempted entry into a secured area, trigger on-site alarms, and alert a registered phone number.
products.metalBody: Walk-through metal detection and X-ray luggage inspection for high-security sites.
products.fireBody: Detection, notification, and integration into a site-wide command-and-control centre.
products.hrmBody: Unif1ed HRM Solution being our premiere product is an in-house software made for aiding companies manage their workforce.
products.hrmLong: Being designed as an Employee management and Payroll software, it specifically caters to the needs of companies concerned with those needs. iSense Technologies is a provider of physical security solutions, which include but are not limited to importing physical devices that have support for fingerprint, face, card, and pin code authorization. Every manufacturer of these devices provides their own software. The variety of software makes it difficult for customers to use our services easily. To solve these issues, Unif1ed HRM was created. The software gets its name from being able to unify different devices from different manufacturers. It works seamlessly with devices we import and is provided as a Software as a Service (SAAS).
products.hrmAttendanceBody: Unif1ed HRM helps you keep track of your employees' attendance. The system can be configured however you want it to be. You don’t need to change how you work, Unif1ed will adjust to your ways. Unif1ed has support for an unlimited number of employees and shift configurations. Breaks on the day, like tea and lunch breaks, are also available. The information collected is displayed in a variety of report types to help you visualize your employees’ performance and aid in your decision-making.
products.hrmPayrollBody: Unif1ed HRM is proficient at calculating payroll information and generating a paycheck. Time and Attendance information is used in payroll calculation for salary deduction. Our system is very flexible to accommodate your needs and can be configured to calculate payroll in specific ways to specific employees. Local government laws are also included in the calculation (income tax and pension).
products.moreLead: Access control, attendance, intrusion, detection, fire, and Unif1ed HRM — specified per site.
